caption: One identical request goes to every lead. Phone numbers are the ones published on the official CSLB licence record, so the number in this table and the number in the licence record are the same number.

channels.ask: Say you need one written quote for two paths: try the tub side first, then open the storage-unit ceiling and restore it. Ask who does the drywall patch, texture and paint, and ask for the licence number to check.

Ask them to quote the same two paths. Their active licence has no B or C-9, so require a BPC §7059(a)/16 CCR §831 incidental-and-essential rationale or the named appropriately licensed restoration party and contract structure. The contract must name active #1089561 TARO GROUP INC dba HEISES PLUMBING.

Ask the same two-path question. Their licence carries both general building and plumbing classifications, so ask them to name in writing who performs the ceiling restoration and who supervises the plumbing.
Ask the same two-path question as a fourth quote. Their licence carries both general building and plumbing classifications; no published scope evidence covers this small repair yet.
Ask the same two-path question if a fifth quote is wanted. Their published work is positioned toward larger renovations, so ask directly whether they take a repair of this size.

Ask for a quote on the ceiling half alone: open or enlarge the access, patch, tape, texture and paint back to the existing finish. Ask them to state whether they work under the plumber or under the owner.

Ask them to requote the same two-path scope so the earlier supplied amount can be compared line by line. Their licence carries C-36 only; require a BPC §7059(a) incidental-work rationale or the named restoration party.
Ask them to requote the same two-path scope. Their licence carries the plumbing classification only, so ask who does the patch.
Ask them to requote the same two-path scope. Their licence carries the plumbing classification only, so ask who does the patch.

script.purpose: A copy-ready message. Every ranked lead is asked the same four questions so the replies can be compared line by line.
questions: Who performs the drywall patch, texture and paint? If you are the specialty prime, document why that work is incidental, supplemental and essential under BPC §7059(a) and 16 CCR §831; otherwise name the appropriately licensed restoration party and contract structure.
One itemised price covering both paths, with the ceiling restoration as its own line.
The licence number I should check on the CSLB lookup, and confirmation that the licence covers this scope.
How an occupied unit is protected: tenant notice, dust containment, water shut-off and clean-up.
